_comment: Scoped scenario battery for the 2026-08-19 BOTH APPOINTMENTS FLOW back-port (see the file's own header note). Covers the Friday-adapted logic that is new relative to the shared node_7b file's batch-reschedule scenarios (nodes/shared/node_7b_rescheduler_scenarios.json) -- the FRIDAY-ONLY FRAMING prepend and the FRIDAY REDIRECT check applied to each of the two day/time answers. Tag 'friday-both-appointments' scopes this set; 'core' is the bare-minimum trigger check.

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS trigger — Friday framing prepended on first ask, no tool call

history.content: Actually, they need to be an hour later, both of them.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent recognises BOTH APPOINTMENTS (linked_appointment_id set + 'both of them'), asks a variant of 'What time would you like your appointment moved to?' PREPENDED with the Friday-only framing sentence ('we only run appointments on Fridays' or equivalent, since this is the first day/time ask this call), and makes NO tool call this turn. Does NOT attempt to calculate 'an hour later' itself, does NOT ask who the other appointment belongs to (Peter is already known via linked_appointment_label). FAIL if: agent omits the Friday framing sentence, calls any tool this turn, or states a computed time without asking the caller.

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS — FRIDAY REDIRECT fires on caller's own appointment, caller agrees

history.content: Actually, they need to move, both of them.
Just so you know, we only run appointments on Fridays. What time would you like your appointment moved to?
Next Wednesday at 10 AM.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent detects Wednesday is not Friday and asks 'We're only able to do Fridays, I'm afraid — would a Friday work instead?' with NO tool call this turn — does NOT silently accept Wednesday, does NOT proceed to ask about Peter's appointment yet. FAIL if: agent proceeds to ask about the linked appointment's time, calls any tool, or accepts a non-Friday day without the redirect question.

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS — caller agrees to Friday redirect, agent moves to linked appointment's time (no tool call, no spoken date)

history.content: Actually, they need to move, both of them.
Just so you know, we only run appointments on Fridays. What time would you like your appointment moved to?
Next Wednesday at 10 AM.
We're only able to do Fridays, I'm afraid — would a Friday work instead?
Yeah, that's fine.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent silently resolves the day to the next Friday on or after today (does not ask the caller to state a specific Friday date, does not speak the resolved date beyond confirming what's needed), makes NO tool call, and asks 'And what time should Peter's appointment move to?'. FAIL if: agent calls smart_voice_agent before Peter's time is known, asks the caller to name a specific Friday date themselves, or re-asks for the time already given (10 AM).

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS — caller declines Friday redirect with no alternative day — wrap_up

history.content: Actually, they need to move, both of them.
Just so you know, we only run appointments on Fridays. What time would you like your appointment moved to?
Next Wednesday at 10 AM.
We're only able to do Fridays, I'm afraid — would a Friday work instead?
No, that doesn't work for me.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks one filler phrase then calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' — does NOT ask about Peter's appointment, does NOT call smart_voice_agent, does NOT claim anything was rescheduled. FAIL if: agent proceeds to ask about the linked appointment, calls any other tool, or fails to call wrap_up.

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS — relative time guard fires on second (linked) appointment's time

history.content: Actually, they need to move, both of them.
Just so you know, we only run appointments on Fridays. What time would you like your appointment moved to?
This Friday at 10 AM.
And what time should Peter's appointment move to?
Same as before, just an hour on.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent asks 'What time exactly would you like that to be?' with NO tool call — does not compute 'an hour on' from any prior time itself. FAIL if: agent silently calculates a time and proceeds toward the reschedule call without asking for an exact answer.

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS — both times already on Friday, both known — reschedule call with additional_targets

history.content: Actually, they need to move, both of them.
Just so you know, we only run appointments on Fridays. What time would you like your appointment moved to?
This Friday, the 21st, at 10 AM.
And what time should Peter's appointment move to?
Also this Friday the 21st, at 10:30 AM.

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says 'Let me lock those in.' AND calls smart_voice_agent intent='reschedule' with new_date/new_time for the caller's own appointment (2026-08-21 / 10:00) AND additional_targets containing one entry with appointment_id='PETER_APPT_1', new_date='2026-08-21', new_time='10:30', label='Peter', in the same turn — both dates already fall on a Friday so no redirect question should appear anywhere in this turn. FAIL if: agent asks the Friday-redirect question (both dates are already Friday), omits the spoken phrase, omits additional_targets, calls intent='book' instead of 'reschedule', or splits this into two separate tool calls.

scenarios.name: BOTH APPOINTMENTS success — verbatim message covering both, wrap_up same turn

history.content: Let me lock those in.

[smart_voice_agent response]: {"success": true, "message": "Perfect! I've rescheduled your appointment to Friday, August 21st at 10 AM and Peter's to Friday, August 21st at 10:30 AM.", "rescheduled_appointments": [{"label": "primary"}, {"label": "Peter"}]}

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent speaks the message verbatim AND calls universal_router intent='wrap_up' in the same turn with zero additional spoken output. FAIL if: agent paraphrases, asks a follow-up question, or omits the wrap_up call.

scenarios.name: NOT both appointments — linked_appointment_id empty, ordinary single reschedule must use FRIDAY REDIRECT from AVAILABILITY STEP, not BOTH APPOINTMENTS FLOW

history.content: Can we push my appointment back an hour?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent does NOT enter BOTH APPOINTMENTS FLOW (linked_appointment_id is empty) — proceeds through the ordinary RESCHEDULE BYPASS path instead, asking the AVAILABILITY STEP day/time question (with Friday framing, since this is the first ask this call) with no tool call. FAIL if: agent asks about a second appointment, references Peter or any other party, or otherwise behaves as if a linked appointment exists.
